verses.translation: Wherefore did the heathen rage, and the nations imagine vain things?

translations.ron: Pentru ce s-au întărâtat neamurile şi popoarele au cugetat deşertăciuni?
translations.grk: Ἱνατί ἐφρύαξαν ἔθνη, καὶ λαοὶ ἐμελέτησαν κενά;

verses.translation: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers gathered themselves together, against the Lord, and against his Christ;

translations.ron: S-au ridicat împăraţii pământului şi căpeteniile s-au adunat împreună împotriva Domnului şi a unsului Său, zicând:
translations.grk: Παρέστησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς, καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες συνήχθησαν ἐπιτοαυτὸ κατὰ τοῦ Κυρίου, καὶ κατὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: saying, Let us break through their bonds, and cast away their yoke from us.

translations.ron: Să rupem legăturile lor şi să lepădăm de la noi jugul lor .
translations.grk: Διαῤῥήξωμεν τοὺς δεσμοὺς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀποῤῥίψωμεν ἀφʼ ἡμῶν τὸν ζυγὸν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: He that dwells in the heavens shall laugh them to scorn, and the Lord shall mock them.

translations.ron: Cel ce locuieşte în ceruri va râde de dânşii şi Domnul îi va batjocori pe ei!
translations.grk: Ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἐκγελάσεται αὐτοὺς, καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἐκμυκτηριεῖ αὐτούς.

verses.translation: Then shall he speak to them in his anger, and trouble them in his fury.

translations.ron: Atunci va grăi către ei întru urgia Lui şi întru mânia Lui îi va tulbura pe ei;
translations.grk: Τότε λαλήσει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτοῦ ταράξει αὐτούς.

verses.translation: But I have been made king by him on Sion his holy mountain,

translations.ron: Iar Eu sunt pus împărat de El peste Sion, muntele cel sfânt al Lui, vestind porunca Domnului.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ κατεστάθην βασιλεὺς ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Σιὼν ὄρος τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ,

verses.translation: declaring the ordinance of the Lord: the Lord said to me, Thou art my Son, to-day have I begotten thee.

translations.ron: Domnul a zis către Mine: "Fiul Meu eşti Tu, Eu astăzi Te-am născut!
translations.grk: διαγγέλλων τὸ πρόσταγμα Κυρίου· Κύριος εἶπε πρὸς μὲ, υἱός μου εἶ σὺ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε.

verses.translation: Ask of me, and I will give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the ends of the earth for thy possession.

translations.ron: Cere de la Mine şi-Ţi voi da neamurile moştenirea Ta şi stăpânirea Ta marginile pământului.
translations.grk: Αἴτησαι παρʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ δώσω σοι ἔθνη τὴν κληρονομίαν σου, καὶ τὴν κατάσχεσίν σου τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς.

verses.translation: Thou shalt rule them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces as a potter's vessel.

translations.ron: Le vei paşte pe ele cu toiag de fier; ca pe vasul olarului le vei zdrobi!"
translations.grk: Ποιμανεῖς αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ, ὡς σκεῦος κεραμέως συντρίψεις αὐτούς.

verses.translation: Now therefore understand, ye kings: be instructed, all ye that judge the earth.

translations.ron: Şi acum împăraţi înţelegeţi! Învăţaţi-vă toţi, care judecaţi pământul!
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν βασιλεῖς σύνετε, παιδεύθητε πάντες οἱ κρίνοντες τὴν γῆν.

verses.translation: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice in him with trembling.

translations.ron: Slujiţi Domnului cu frică şi vă bucuraţi de El cu cutremur.
translations.grk: Δουλεύσατε τῷ Κυρίῳ ἐν φόβῳ, καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε αὐτῷ ἐν τρόμῳ.

verses.translation: Accept correction, lest at any time the Lord be angry, and ye should perish from the righteous way: whensoever his wrath shall be suddenly kindled, blessed are all they that trust in him.

translations.ron: Luaţi învăţătură, ca nu cumva să Se mânie Domnul şi să pieriţi din calea cea dreaptă, când se va aprinde degrab mânia Lui! Fericiţi toţi cei ce nădăjduiesc în El.
translations.grk: Δράξασθε παιδείας, μή ποτε ὀργισθῇ Κύριος, καὶ ἀπολεῖσθε ἐξ ὁδοῦ δικαίας· ὅταν ἐκκαυθῇ ἐν τάχει ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ, μακάριοι πάντες οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπʼ αὐτῷ.
